title: rimi. convention, machine-readable projection
description: Shape of convention.json, produced from en.md by tools/build_convention_json.py. The text is the source; this file is only its projection. If the two diverge, en.md prevails.

convention_version.description: Version of the convention, as stated on the first lines of en.md.

generated_at.description: When this file was built, UTC. The only field that depends on the run: it is excluded from every comparison and from the fingerprints.

text_sha256.description: SHA-256 of en.md, the normative text this projection was built from.

rules.description: Every rule of Parts A, B and C, ordered by part then by number.

conformance.description: Levels A, AA and AAA, as published in the convention.

frugality.description: Indicators S1, S2 and S3, scored separately from conformance.

must_pass_rate.description: Share of runs a MUST or MUST NOT obligation must pass.

should_pass_rate.description: Share of runs a SHOULD recommendation must pass.

stable_status.description: What a rule must pass before it reaches Stable status.

part.description: A: LLM behaviour. B: design of prompts and tools. C: frugality.

type.description: Kind of rule. Only Parts A and B carry one; Part C rules have none, hence null. invariant_and_default is a rule that states an invariant and a default convention in the same breath (read as 'Invariant + default' in the text).

wave.description: Review wave the rule is discussed in.

principle.description: The principle the rule derives from.

summary.description: The convention as the text states it, verbatim.

obligations.description: The summary cut into its obligations, one per modal verb. SHOULD NOT appears in the text of Part C and is admitted here.

rule_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the rule's source extract in en.md: its table row, or its whole section for a rule written out in full. A rule whose text changes changes fingerprint.
